name: mail-orders-not-arriving
description: A partner reports that no orders have arrived since 09:00 UTC and asks for a check: a current failure that OcuTalon can look into with its read-only tools, so it acts.

item.subject: No orders received since 09:00 UTC
item.text: Hello, our system shows that your side has received no orders from us since 09:00 UTC today, although we are sending them as usual. Please check what your production is doing with the incoming orders and tell us what you find. Thanks, Order Partner Operations
